description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, a first floor side extension, installation of six front roof windows, alterations to windows and doors on all elevations. Installation of railings, gate and bin store in the front garden. Proposed rationalisation of external soil and rainwater pipe layout. Installation of solar panels to the southern and western sides of the roof pitch. Installation of two air source heat pump in the rear garden.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, with a splay of at least 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres) shall be provided before the access and parking area is brought into use.  These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
Condition : 5 - The level of noise emitted from heat pumps and the fan coil unit shall be at least 10dB below the background noise levels at all times near to the noise sensitive receptors.
